conditions: KDE/XWayland X11, 800x600 scale1, fixed embedded font. Opt/base pairs interleaved with alternating order. Eight startups each (first-observed separate, seven warm), five runs per update endpoint, each 20 warmups +100 samples. No cache eviction or cold-start claim.
startupEndpoint: Rust main to softbuffer first render/present return; no compositor acknowledgement. Spawn-to-exit separately includes loader and IPC.
updateEndpoint: Dispatch, binding mutation and style/layout resolve; excludes paint.
paintEndpoint: Dispatch, mutation, style/layout resolve plus CPU scene rendering into a fresh framebuffer (renderer commands reset each iteration). No window presentation, compositor acknowledgement or OS input latency.
